description: Governor Kay Ivey on Wednesday signed Senate Bill 1, sponsored by Sen. Garlan Gudger and Rep. Jamie Kiel, which will strengthen the fairness and integrity of Alabama elections. Upon signing the bill banning ballot harvesting, the governor issued the following statement: “Here in Alabama, we are committed to ensuring our elections are free and fair. […]
title: Governor signs Senate Bill 1, bans ballot harvesting - Jamie Kiel for State Representative
